title: 녹스
prompt:
INPUT: the attached image is the approved character; keep her.

CHARACTER: the same woman as the attached image — the personification of the game «녹스» (action role-playing game). Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut, skin tone and body proportions; expression and hair motion may change.

NOT ITS CHARACTERS: an original woman who is the game itself — no face or body of its hero, mascot, characters or creatures (she may wear their outfits); no title logo, box art, real brands, HUD overlay or readable text and numbers. Its items, places, colors, gear and interface shapes may appear recognizably.

NEVER DRAW for this game: "원작 인물(잭 모워·헤케바)의 얼굴"; "괴물(좀비·오우거 등)의 얼굴과 몸"; "로고·타이틀 글자"; "피 묘사"; "체력·마나 숫자".

STYLE: Glossy Korean mobile-game character art with an elegant anime face, smooth dimensional shading, luminous color accents and refined fabric and accessory rendering. Keep highlights selective and the figure sharply readable.

SIGNATURE (this one only, as an accessory or an object in the scene — never printed on or woven into the clothes): "판타지 숲에 떨어진 은빛 트레일러 하우스".

AGE: keep her age as in the attached image; add no wrinkles, folds or under-eye shadows, even when she smiles.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her in the outfit chosen in SCENE; her game shows only through accessories and objects around her — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never her form costume, its characters or logo. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the image for this frame; COMPOSITION in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

CROP: a close-up — her face and hair fill most of the frame and the bottom edge crosses at her collarbones; nothing below the shoulders shows, and her hands and anything she holds stay below the frame unless raised to her face. This crop wins over every other line: details apply only to the part that shows, and the outfit reads through its visible neckline, straps, fabric and colour. Never widen the framing to show a hidden support, hand or leg; a limb crossing the edge runs naturally on past it, never cut off or fading out inside the image.

SETTING: a stylised stage, editorial or fantasy set, not bound to a real year — still one real adult woman in a believable space, no creatures.

SCENE (chosen):
Place: a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars
Outfit: matching bathhouse loungewear with a towel folded into a sheep-ear headband
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; head tilted slightly; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right fingertips rest lightly on her cheek.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: one mouth corner lifted higher than the other, lips closed.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more bare shoulder and collarbone inside the crop; the crop stays exactly where CROP sets it and never moves down to show more; cover the chest
action_level: mostly active — an active mid-action moment compatible with the selected pose
source_influence: strong — her game is clearly recognizable through a few accessories and props in the scene, never through the outfit's colours, patterns or cut
separates_preference: strongly prefer separates — use separate top and bottom by default; a garment named in the chosen Outfit takes priority

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face, hair and body — not its garment, layers, sash, tassels, jewelry, hair ornaments or background. Dress her exactly as SCENE describes; the part of that outfit inside the crop must read at first glance in its own colours. Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her game belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her own costume, genre or palette.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera as SCENE describes, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same.

ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus. Where the place is busy, other people may appear only as small, soft-focus background extras — never posed with her and never a character from her game. No text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border, no game interface or score.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame. Right and left mean her own right and left, not the viewer's.

HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may stay outside the crop, and fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.

FINAL CHECK: glossy Korean mobile-game rendering with selective highlights; an original costume — no character, logo, title lettering or interface from the game.
